summary: Mode-dependent score threshold check. Returns true (1) by default. Dispatches on global dword_7D0308 (via jump table jpt_418B9D): mode 0 tests dword_5BF9A0[5*a1] == 0x7FFFFFFF, mode 1 tests >= 70, mode 2 tests >= 40, mode 3 tests > 0; any other mode leaves the default result 1. The 5*a1 index implies a 5-dword-per-entry record stride in dword_5BF9A0. Called by InsertDriverTableEntry and CarSelectionStateMachine.

operations.description: Switch on global dword_7D0308 (mode selector), dispatched through jump table jpt_418B9D.
Return result; the default branch returns the unchanged initial value 1.

unresolved: Meaning of the dword_7D0308 mode enum (0..3) is unknown.
Semantics of dword_5BF9A0 and its 5-dword-per-entry record stride are unknown from this function alone.
Callers InsertDriverTableEntry and CarSelectionStateMachine are the only known call sites.
